zh-Hant: Before為獨立冷開自然敗北，After為各自原封自然存檔正常Continue，非新自然十波。
每角色N=1、知情續測、學習、行動、RNG消耗及恢復時序不同，非嚴格因果A/B。A-after為新實例，B/C讀自己的Before。
全場Before與短After總輸入不可當效率比較；送出不等於命令接受，結算後輸入不算有效作戰命令。
After累積時間/採集/擊殺帶入存檔前歷程；matchedWindows才界定本段增量，但仍不是因果效果。
每5秒正庫存差僅分項收入下界；存活轉變含到期及漏採樣，不是完整戰鬥死傷。target/attack參照不是傷害歸因；congested可能歷史殘留。
Restore帶入既有卡牌及冷卻；boon/技能變化不能直接當本段新領卡或施放。
整工作階段FPS含選單/暫停；100/200負載四案各30秒且有原生死亡，非持續固定100/200存活。
SwiftShader為CPU軟體繪圖，不是實體GPU。200 After heap較高，起終點不能證明有/無洩漏，長測未證明。
Strict RNG Save/Load -1129663591→3165303705仍FAIL；新UI不額外消耗RNG不等於修復嚴格重播。
自然十波未抵達、NG+未測；沒有真人聽感、樂趣、留存、平衡因果或勝率改善證據。
下一旗手人工入口正實作，尚無新來源/構建/測試，不能沿用第一切片PASS。
en: Before sessions are independent cold-start natural defeats; After sessions resume each unchanged natural save through normal Continue, not fresh ten-wave campaigns.
N=1 per role, informed retesting, learning, actions, RNG consumption and restore timing preclude strict causal A/B. A-after is a new instance; B/C read their own Before.
Whole Before and short After input totals are not efficiency comparisons. Dispatch is not semantic acceptance; post-terminal input is not an effective combat order.
After cumulative time/gathering/kills include pre-save history. Matched windows define segment deltas but do not establish causal effects.

Five-second positive inventory deltas are income lower bounds. Alive transitions include expiry and sampling gaps, not complete casualties. Target/attack references do not attribute damage; congested may be historical.
Restore carries existing cards and cooldowns. Boon/cooldown changes cannot all be counted as new claims/casts in this segment.
Whole-session FPS includes menus/pauses. Four initial-100/200 cases each last 30 seconds with native deaths, not sustained fixed survivor counts.
SwiftShader is CPU software rendering, not physical GPU hardware. The 200-unit After heap is higher; endpoints establish neither a leak nor no leak, and long runs remain unproven.
Strict RNG Save/Load -1129663591→3165303705 remains FAIL. Read-only UI consuming no additional RNG does not repair strict replay.
Natural ten waves were not reached and NG+ is untested. No human listening, fun, retention, balance causality or win-rate improvement is established.
The next carrier entry is being implemented without a new source/build/tests and cannot inherit the first-slice passes.

matchedWindows.comparison: 角色各自同一原始自然快照之後的窗口；不是角色間相同起點的新三場戰役，也不是嚴格因果A/B。保留學習、動作與RNG差異。
matchedWindows.dispatch_limit: 成功送出不代表指令語意接受；結算後輸入另列，絕非有效集火。
matchedWindows.income_limit: gathered為原生總交付，資源淨變化不是完整分項收入；不虛構卡牌造成傷害的歸因。
